audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 against 52.34% over 1154 games. The lane's difficulty is terrain-dependent rather than flat: Terrashape is a 1100-range dash on a 7s cooldown but only arms an element next to a wall, brush or rock, so the same matchup is played differently in open lane than next to the river wall. The existing arc (yours 3-5, hers at 6) is consistent with Audacity's 11s versus her 120s ultimate.
